name: Talhindir's Despair

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor

disable: DC 20 Performance check (trained) to overpower the frightening cries with a greater sound or DC 18 Occultism check or DC 18 Religion check (trained) to ritually disrupt the haunting.
reset: If the haunt is not dispersed, it resets after 1 day.

items.name: The Falling Tears
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the carving of Viore Ciobanu

---
Effect Blood begins to rain from the ceiling. The cries from the statues deal 2d10+13 mental damage to living creatures within the room (DC 20 basic Will save save). On a failed save, creatures are also Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 and Fleeing for 1 minute on a critical failure).

text: Gentle crying rises to become overwhelming wails. The fungal carvings begin to weep blood that pools around the pillars
